description: OLE-PARAM discovery: for Commands on the saved queries QMulti (five parameters declared as pB, pA, pC, pD, pY), QParam, QAction, QEmpty and QSel (adCmdStoredProc) and on text commands with three '?' markers, an inline PARAMETERS clause, an INSERT with two markers and a SELECT with one marker, read NamedParameters and the Parameters inventory (Count; Name, Type, Direction, Size, Precision, NumericScale, Attributes, Value) before and after an explicit Refresh, and the Connection Errors. Asks which commands describe their parameters, in what order and with which types.

args.text: SELECT ID FROM Items WHERE Code = ? AND L > ? AND C = ?
PARAMETERS pX Long, pY Text(5); SELECT ID FROM Items WHERE L = pX AND Code = pY;
SELECT ID FROM Items WHERE Code = ?
